verdict.rationale: ADK docs describe an evaluation framework where test files represent single agent-model interactions/sessions (google-adk-docs-8), and a built-in dev UI helps test/evaluate/debug agents (google-adk-gh-3), suggesting some testing infrastructure exists. However, there is no explicit evidence of unit-testing with mocked models or mocked tools specifically. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of model/tool mocking APIs, examples of dependency injection for tests, and independent confirmation that these test flows support isolated unit tests rather than full evaluation runs.
